messages:
Alex (Sales): heads-up — just closed Heliosync (enterprise). Signed yesterday. They need a dedicated trial + SSO + VPC. sending handoff now.
Maria (CS): congrats! pls include biz context and any red flags.
Alex (Sales): quick context: Heliosync is a ML observability vendor. Contract 12mo, ARR $220k, go-live target in 6 weeks.
Alex (Sales): key asks from customer: 1) Dedicated pilot (2x A100-equivalent) 2) SSO via Okta (SAML) 3) Private VPC peering + egress rules 4) baseline latency <100ms for gen endpoints.
Alex (Sales): notes on data: they will send non-PII product telemetry for embeddings and reranking. Legal signed standard DPA + SOC2 addendum.
Maria (CS): thanks. renewal risk? anything we should flag?
Alex (Sales): Renewal not a near-term risk but they stated high sensitivity to latency/cost. If the pilot performs poorly they'll push to an alternative.
Maria (CS): oof — we'll prioritize perf verification. Assigning owners: Maria -> overall CS owner, Jon -> support for infra/provisioning, Tara -> eng for perf tuning and model selection.
Maria (CS): @Jon can you start a provisioning ticket with cloud infra team for a dedicated trial pool? include required GPU count and region (us-west-2).
Jon (Support): on it. I'll open ECC ticket and schedule a provisioning window. ETA for initial pool: 3 business days if no quota issues.
Tara (Eng): can you add perf SLOs to the ticket? We need sequence length expectations and QPS. Heliosync expects approx 200 concurrent sessions, avg seq len 256 tokens, peak QPS ~ 180.
Alex (Sales): adding that: expected traffic profile: 180 QPS peak, 12k tokens/session daily, mostly chat+rerank.
Maria (CS): noted. I'll create a customer readiness doc and enablement plan. Will run a quick prompt set for quality baselines during pilot.
Maria (CS): also capture Okta metadata — Alex, can you get their IdP metadata and the SP-ACS URL?
Alex (Sales): already requested from their IT. should have by EOD.
Jon (Support): provisional checklist I'm adding to ticket:
```
- create dedicated GPU pool (2 nodes A100 equiv) in us-west-2
- network: VPC peering + allow egress 443 to S3 endpoints
- configure SAML IdP with SP ACS URL
- allocate a test subdomain + TLS cert
- enable KV-prefix caching for embeddings
```
Jon (Support): once infra is up I'll hand to Tara for runtime perf tuning.
Tara (Eng): for perf tuning I'll try these steps: smaller kv cache warmup, quantized model variant for low-cost fallback, and dynamic batching with max latency 80ms target.
Tara (Eng): can we get a representative prompt set? need 50-100 queries with typical payloads.
Maria (CS): I'll coordinate with Heliosync PM to deliver the prompt set and a sample payload.
Alex (Sales): they also want an onboarding walkthrough with devs + 2-hour enablement session next Thurs. Maria pls own scheduling.
Maria (CS): will coordinate. Proposed owners and next steps: [Maria] kickoff + enablement scheduling; [Jon] open ECC ticket + provision pool; [Tara] perf tuning + run baseline eval; [Alex] deliver IdP metadata and customer prompts.
Maria (CS): risk log: latency expectation strict => tag as HIGH. If initial pilot misses SLO, escalate to eng-oncall and consider fallback model.
Oncall Bot: Incident channel created: #inc-6141592653-helio-pilot. Pager rotation notified.
Jon (Support): ticket created: ECC-84210. I linked this thread and added the checklist. First provisioning run scheduled Mon 09:00 PT.
Maria (CS): thanks team — I'll update the enablement doc and ping when I have the prompt set and IdP metadata.
Alex (Sales): one more: they asked about cost estimates for 3-month pilot vs scaled production. I attached a rough calc in the sales notes; Maria can we add a cost slide for kickoff?
Maria (CS): yes — I'll draft a cost / ops expectations slide and attach to the kickoff.
Tara (Eng): tagging follow-ups for me: once pool is up send perf run commands and I'll iterate on batching params.
Maria (CS): perfect. closing loop here — will post updates to #customer-helio and link to this thread. :raised_hands:
